svg.title: Red Ribbon
svg.desc: A red banner ribbon folded into an R lying on its side: the top tail runs across, a second strand hangs under it beside the dark underside of the fold, and the right tail kicks out at the foot. Thin gaps mark the folds, so it reads in one colour too. Drawn by logo-study gen6.py (round 6, As drawn) and flattened to plain paths by flatten6.py, 2026-11-24.
